offering_description.value: Provides engineering, consulting, architecture, construction and operations services for infrastructure, facilities, defense and government clients. Sells mainly project-based services and long-term operations contracts, delivered by its own professionals.

primary_services.value: engineering design; consulting; construction management; operations and maintenance; program management; cybersecurity and digital services

customer_segment.value: B2G: federal, state and local government agencies, defense and transportation authorities; B2B: industrial companies, utilities, commercial property owners, life sciences firms

end_markets.value: transportation; water; defense and national security; energy and chemicals; buildings and facilities

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fees for engineering, construction and program management projects under contracts; service fees: long-term operations, maintenance and facility management contracts

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in client project requirements and engineering talent, sells design, delivery and operations services to government and private owners

geography_served.value: global: operates in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East and other regions worldwide

specialization.value: diversified: separate businesses for infrastructure, critical mission and defense, advanced facilities and government services, serving different customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: business development teams selling contracts directly to government and corporate clients

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, safety and government procurement rules, plus security clearance requirements for defense work
